title: Stockpile — Store
description: The shop's business: what sold and what it made, what is listed and what it would bring, what is on hand, and how the marketplace and drop-ship machinery is doing. Sales follow the time picker; 'now' panels don't. Profit is before marketplace and card fees, on the lines whose cost is known.

list.name: shop
list.label: Shop
list.query: SELECT slug AS __value, name AS __text FROM "Tenant" WHERE active ORDER BY "createdAt"
list.definition: SELECT slug AS __value, name AS __text FROM "Tenant" WHERE active ORDER BY "createdAt"

list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.query: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT l."timeZone" FROM "Location" l JOIN "Tenant" t ON t.id = l."tenantId" WHERE t.slug = '$shop' AND l."timeZone" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l."createdAt" LIMIT 1), 'America/New_York')
list.definition: the shop's first store's time zone

panels.title: Sales

targets.rawSql: WITH listed AS ( SELECT cl.id, cl.channel, cl.title, cl.format, cl."bidCount", cl.watchers, cl."endsAt", cl."firstSeenAt", cl."highBid", GREATEST(COALESCE(cl.quantity, 1), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(CASE WHEN cl.format = 'FIXED' THEN cl.price END, cl."buyNowPrice", GREATEST(cl.price, cl."highBid")) AS ask, CASE WHEN cl."dropShipProductId" IS NOT NULL OR cl."dropShip" THEN 'Drop-ship' WHEN cl."inventoryUnitId" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Serialized (on hand)' WHEN cl."stockLevelId" IS NOT NULL OR cl."productId" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shop stock (on hand)' ELSE 'Not linked' END AS source, CASE WHEN cl."dropShipProductId" IS NOT NULL OR cl."dropShip" THEN NULLIF(cl."dropShipCost", 0) WHEN cl."inventoryUnitId" IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT NULLIF(u.cost, 0) FROM "NfaItem" u WHERE u.id = cl."inventoryUnitId" AND u.cost > 0) WHEN cl."productId" IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE( (SELECT rl."unitCost" FROM "ReceivingLine" rl JOIN "ReceivingBatch" rb ON rb.id = rl."batchId" WHERE rl."tenantId" = cl."tenantId" AND rl."productId" = cl."productId" AND rl."unitCost" > 0 ORDER BY rb."receivedDate" DESC, rl."updatedAt" DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT min(v.cost) FROM "TenantVendorPrice" v WHERE v."tenantId" = cl."tenantId" AND v."productId" = cl."productId" AND v.cost > 0)) END AS unit_cost FROM "ChannelListing" cl WHERE cl."tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop') AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT cl.sandbox ) SELECT COALESCE(sum(ask * qty), 0) AS "Value" FROM listed

WITH onhand AS ( SELECT 'Serialized' AS what, u.ownership::text AS ownership, COALESCE(CASE WHEN u."itemType"::text IN ('SUPPRESSOR','SBR','SBS','AOW','MACHINE_GUN','DESTRUCTIVE_DEVICE') THEN 'NFA' WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Guns' END, 'Guns') AS kind, 1 AS qty, u."askingPrice" AS price, NULLIF(u.cost, 0) AS unit_cost, COALESCE(u."receivedDate"::timestamp, u."createdAt") AS since FROM "NfaItem" u WHERE u."tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop') AND u.status IN ('IN_STOCK', 'RESERVED') UNION ALL SELECT 'Stock', 'SHOP', COALESCE(CASE p.class::text WHEN 'HANDGUN' THEN 'Guns' WHEN 'LONG_GUN' THEN 'Guns' WHEN 'NFA' THEN 'NFA' WHEN 'AMMUNITION' THEN 'Ammo' WHEN 'OPTIC' THEN 'Optics' WHEN 'MAGAZINE' THEN 'Magazines' WHEN 'ACCESSORY' THEN 'Accessories' WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 'Other' END, 'Other'), sl."onHand", tp."shelfPrice", COALESCE( (SELECT rl."unitCost" FROM "ReceivingLine" rl JOIN "ReceivingBatch" rb ON rb.id = rl."batchId" WHERE rl."tenantId" = sl."tenantId" AND rl."productId" = sl."productId" AND rl."unitCost" > 0 ORDER BY rb."receivedDate" DESC, rl."updatedAt" DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT min(v.cost) FROM "TenantVendorPrice" v WHERE v."tenantId" = sl."tenantId" AND v."productId" = sl."productId" AND v.cost > 0)), NULL FROM "StockLevel" sl JOIN "Product" p ON p.id = sl."productId" LEFT JOIN "TenantProduct" tp ON tp."tenantId" = sl."tenantId" AND tp."productId" = sl."productId" WHERE sl."tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop') AND sl."onHand" > 0 ) SELECT kind AS "Kind", what AS "Tracked as", sum(qty) AS "Units", sum(price * qty) AS "Retail value", sum(unit_cost * qty) AS "Cost", sum((price - unit_cost) * qty) AS "Profit if sold", sum(qty) FILTER (WHERE price IS NULL) AS "No price", sum(qty) FILTER (WHERE unit_cost IS NULL) AS "No cost" FROM onhand WHERE ownership = 'SHOP' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Serialized units by age
panels.description: Shop-owned guns and NFA items in stock, by days since received: the money sitting in each age band.

targets.rawSql: WITH onhand AS ( SELECT 'Serialized' AS what, u.ownership::text AS ownership, COALESCE(CASE WHEN u."itemType"::text IN ('SUPPRESSOR','SBR','SBS','AOW','MACHINE_GUN','DESTRUCTIVE_DEVICE') THEN 'NFA' WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Guns' END, 'Guns') AS kind, 1 AS qty, u."askingPrice" AS price, NULLIF(u.cost, 0) AS unit_cost, COALESCE(u."receivedDate"::timestamp, u."createdAt") AS since FROM "NfaItem" u WHERE u."tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop') AND u.status IN ('IN_STOCK', 'RESERVED') UNION ALL SELECT 'Stock', 'SHOP', COALESCE(CASE p.class::text WHEN 'HANDGUN' THEN 'Guns' WHEN 'LONG_GUN' THEN 'Guns' WHEN 'NFA' THEN 'NFA' WHEN 'AMMUNITION' THEN 'Ammo' WHEN 'OPTIC' THEN 'Optics' WHEN 'MAGAZINE' THEN 'Magazines' WHEN 'ACCESSORY' THEN 'Accessories' WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 'Other' END, 'Other'), sl."onHand", tp."shelfPrice", COALESCE( (SELECT rl."unitCost" FROM "ReceivingLine" rl JOIN "ReceivingBatch" rb ON rb.id = rl."batchId" WHERE rl."tenantId" = sl."tenantId" AND rl."productId" = sl."productId" AND rl."unitCost" > 0 ORDER BY rb."receivedDate" DESC, rl."updatedAt" DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT min(v.cost) FROM "TenantVendorPrice" v WHERE v."tenantId" = sl."tenantId" AND v."productId" = sl."productId" AND v.cost > 0)), NULL FROM "StockLevel" sl JOIN "Product" p ON p.id = sl."productId" LEFT JOIN "TenantProduct" tp ON tp."tenantId" = sl."tenantId" AND tp."productId" = sl."productId" WHERE sl."tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop') AND sl."onHand" > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN since > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '30 days' THEN '0–30 days' WHEN since > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '90 days' THEN '31–90 days' WHEN since > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '180 days' THEN '91–180 days' WHEN since > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '365 days' THEN '181–365 days' ELSE 'Over a year' END AS bucket, min(since) AS oldest, sum(unit_cost) AS "Cost tied up" FROM onhand WHERE what = 'Serialized' AND ownership = 'SHOP' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Online store: items shown
panels.description: Products on the shop's own online store.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE shown) AS "Shown" FROM "StorefrontListing" WHERE "tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop')

panels.title: Online store: shown and in stock

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE shown AND "inStock") AS "In stock" FROM "StorefrontListing" WHERE "tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop')

panels.title: Online store: value in stock
panels.description: One of each shown, in-stock item at its online price.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(price) FILTER (WHERE shown AND "inStock"), 0) AS "Value" FROM "StorefrontListing" WHERE "tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop')
SELECT count(*) AS "Added" FROM "StorefrontListing" WHERE "tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop') AND $__timeFilter("firstListedAt")

panels.title: Attention
panels.description: Marketplace orders on Needs attention.

targets.expr: sum(max without (pod, instance) (stockpile_orders{shop="$shop", sandbox="false", status="NEEDS_ATTENTION"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Unstarted
panels.description: Oldest unstarted order: the oldest paid NEW order nobody has started (no source chosen). Drop-ship alerts at 1 h.

panels.title: Listings
panels.description: Since the listing sync last read the listings (alerts at 30 min): it keeps quantity listings from overselling.

panels.title: Orders
panels.description: Orders polled: since the last complete orders poll (alerts at 1 h): new sales come in this way.

panels.title: Syncs
panels.description: The last listing sync and orders poll both succeeded.

targets.expr: min(max without (pod, instance) (stockpile_marketplace_listing_sync_last_status{shop="$shop", sandbox="false"})) * min(max without (pod, instance) (stockpile_marketplace_orders_last_status{shop="$shop", sandbox="false"}))

panels.title: Account
panels.description: Paused after a refused login or User-Agent; the owner lifts it.

panels.title: Publishing
panels.description: Publish problems: publishes that failed in the last 24 h, plus ones sent with no clear answer.

targets.expr: sum(max without (pod, instance) (stockpile_listing_problems{shop="$shop", sandbox="false", problem=~"publish_failed_24h|publish_uncertain"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Needs you
panels.description: Listings needing a person — Stockpile listings on Needs attention: stock drift, or a flag only a person clears.

targets.expr: sum(max without (pod, instance) (stockpile_listing_problems{shop="$shop", sandbox="false", problem="needs_person"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Orders by status
panels.description: Open marketplace orders: the work in progress.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (max without (pod, instance) (stockpile_orders{shop="$shop", sandbox="false", status!~"COMPLETE|CANCELLED"}))

panels.title: Ended unsold (last hour) vs live
panels.description: Stockpile's own listings that ended unsold in the hour, as a share of those live. A spike = a mass ending (cost feed, stock or policy).

targets.expr: sum(max without (pod, instance) (stockpile_listings_ended_1h{shop="$shop", sandbox="false"})) / clamp_min(sum(max without (pod, instance) (stockpile_listings_active{shop="$shop", sandbox="false"})), 1)

panels.title: Orders this period
panels.description: Marketplace orders placed in the time range, by where they stand now. Paid to shipped: the average time from payment (or order) to marked shipped.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE o.channel WHEN 'gunbroker' THEN 'GunBroker' ELSE initcap(o.channel) END AS "Channel", o.status::text AS "Status", count(*) AS "Orders", count(*) FILTER (WHERE o."fflRequired") AS "Need an FFL", sum(o."itemsTotal") AS "Items", sum(o."shippingTotal") AS "Shipping", avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM o."shippedAt" - COALESCE(o."paymentReceivedAt", o."orderedAt"))) FILTER (WHERE o."shippedAt" IS NOT NULL) AS "Paid to shipped" FROM "SalesOrder" o WHERE o."tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop') AND NOT o.sandbox AND $__timeFilter(o."orderedAt") GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Catalog funnel

panels.title: To order by hand

panels.title: Oldest unshipped (distributor)

panels.title: Distributor spend (last hour)
panels.description: Cost of the last hour's live sends (the limits hold at $500).

panels.title: Distributor orders this period
panels.description: Drop-ship orders sent to (or made by hand at) a distributor in the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d."pluginId" AS "Distributor", d.mode AS "Mode", d.status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Orders", sum(d.cost) AS "Cost" FROM "DistributorOrder" d WHERE d."tenantId" = (SELECT id FROM "Tenant" WHERE slug = '$shop') AND $__timeFilter(d."createdAt") GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC
